Name: New Escape Rope
Author: iamsaulc
Description:
[b]Ever needed to leave the mines quickly without wasting time, or go back to a previous floor without abandoning your run?[/b]
This mod adds two new items inspired by the iconic Escape Rope from Pokémon, introducing new ways to move within the mines.

[b]Features
[/b]
[u]Escape Rope[/u]
Instantly lets you exit:

[list]
[*]The Mines
[*]Skull Cavern
[*]Volcano Dungeon
[/list]
Ideal for quick escapes or dangerous situations.

[u]Floor Rope[/u]
Allows you to move up one floor in the mines, something not possible in the base game.
Ideal if you forgot something on the previous floor or accidentally clicked a ladder and went down.

[b]Availability
[/b]
Both items can be purchased from the Dwarf in the mines

[b]Integration
[/b]
Items are added via Content Patcher, while the logic is implemented in C# using SMAPI.

[b]Gameplay experience
[/b]
Includes animations and sound effects, with fast and context-aware usage.

[b]Inspiration[/b]

This mod is inspired by the classic Escape Rope from Pokémon, adapted to Stardew Valley to expand exploration options without breaking the core gameplay.
